title: Residual_Assembler: model-agnostic residual assembly and structural sensitivities for Abaqus models
description: Model-agnostic residual assembly and structural sensitivities for Abaqus models. Abaqus never exposes the global residual; this framework assembles it from mesh, element kernels, material response, converged solution fields, loads and constraints, then differentiates it. Companion product to UMAT-OTI.
